{"predictors": [
{"name": "Asset Growth Volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of year-over-year changes in total assets over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with volatile asset growth may be more likely to experience management errors or be in declining industries, leading to lower future returns. Investors may demand a premium to hold these stocks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "difference between the average inventory turnover ratio over the past 2 years and the average inventory turnover ratio over the past 5 years", "rationale": "An increase in inventory turnover may indicate improving operational efficiency or rising demand, leading to higher future returns. Investors may reward firms with accelerating inventory turnover.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Reversal", "construction": "change in capital expenditures over the past year, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "A decrease in capital expenditures may indicate a firm's recognition of over-investment in the past, leading to more efficient allocation of resources and higher future returns. Investors may view this as a positive signal.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "year-over-year change in the number of employees", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing workforces may be experiencing increasing returns to scale or expanding into new markets, leading to higher future returns. Investors may view employee growth as a proxy for firm growth prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Expense Ratio", "construction": "advertising expenses as a percentage of total sales", "rationale": "Firms with high advertising expenses may be investing in brand recognition and customer loyalty, leading to more stable future cash flows and higher returns. Investors may reward firms with strong brand portfolios.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Research and Development Focus", "construction": "research and development expenses as a percentage of total sales, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with a strong focus on research and development may be more likely to innovate and stay ahead of competitors, leading to higher future returns. Investors may view R&D investments as a driver of long-term growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration", "construction": "percentage of total sales attributed to the top 5 customers", "rationale": "Firms with high customer concentration may be more vulnerable to customer-specific risks, leading to lower future returns. Investors may demand a premium to hold these stocks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Industry Diversification", "construction": "number of different SIC codes reported by the firm, scaled by total sales", "rationale": "Firms with diverse industry exposure may be better insulated from industry-specific shocks, leading to more stable future cash flows and higher returns. Investors may view industry diversification as a risk-reducing strategy.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Expansion", "construction": "number of new countries or regions entered by the firm over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms expanding into new geographic markets may be experiencing increasing returns to scale or accessing new customer bases, leading to higher future returns. Investors may view geographic expansion as a driver of long-term growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "number of different suppliers reported by the firm, scaled by total cost of goods sold", "rationale": "Firms with complex supply chains may be more vulnerable to supply chain disruptions, leading to lower future returns. Investors may demand a premium to hold these stocks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
